text: L.D.B. 21/1978(X)(D)THE UNIVERSITIES ACT, No. 16 OF 1978
Order under Section 27(l)(b) read with Section 25A

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 27(1)(b) read with Section 25A of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, 1, Dr. Harini Amarasuriya, the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education, having obtained a report under section 70C of the aforesaid Act, in respect of the SRI LANKA TECHNOLOGY CAMPUS (PVT) LIMITED, a company incorporated in Sri Lanka under the Companies Act, No. 07 of 2007 and bearing registration number PV 101137, being recognized as a Degree Awarding Institute for the purpose of developing higher education leading to the award of the Bachelor of Science Honours in Engineering in Civil Engineering by Order published in Gazette Extraordinary No. 2210/18 of January 13, 2021 and amended by Order published in Gazette Extraordinary No. 2308/29 of December 1, 2022, do hereby further amend the said Order by the substitution for the words “minimum entry qualifications specified herein” appearing in proviso to Condition 2 in Schedule I thereof, of the following:-

“minimum entry qualifications specified herein and shall be eligible to be awarded the Bachelor of Science Honours in Engineering in Civil Engineering, to be effective from 07.05.2015, upon the successful completion of the said degree programme.”.
Dr. Harini Amarasuriya, Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education.Colombo,August 06, 2025.

L.D.B. 21/1978(X)(D)THE UNIVERSITIES ACT, No. 16 OF 1978
Order under Section 27(l)(b) read with Section 25A

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 27(1)(b) read with Section 25A of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, 1, Dr. Harini Amarasuriya, the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education, having obtained a report under section 70C of the aforesaid Act, in respect of the SRI LANKA TECHNOLOGY CAMPUS (PVT) LIMITED, a company incorporated in Sri Lanka under the Companies Act, No.07 of 2007 and bearing registration number PV 101137, being recognized as a Degree Awarding Institute for the purpose of developing higher education leading to the award of the Bachelor of Science Honours in Engineering in Mechatronics Engineering by Order published in Gazette Extraordinary No. 2157/3 of January 6, 2020 and amended by Order published in Gazette Extraordinary No. 2308/29 of December 1, 2022, do hereby further amend the said Order by the substitution for the words “minimum entry qualifications specified herein.” appearing in proviso to paragraph (ii) of Condition 1 in Schedule I thereof, of the following:-

“minimum entry qualifications specified herein and shall be eligible to be awarded the Bachelor of Science Honours in Engineering in Mechatronics Engineering, to be effective from 07.05.2015, upon the successful completion of the said degree programme.”.
Dr. Harini Amarasuriya, Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education.Colombo,August 06, 2025.
